title: Nanoka and Mao
overview: Nanoka is an attuned adolescent. So when a covered shopping arcade beckons, a strange world awaits.

title: Spider Lady
overview: Nanoka discovers that the arcade links to the Taisho era, while Mao probes a mysterious murder case.

title: The Accursed
overview: Nanoka is unharmed by Mao's cursed sword. She returns to modern times to investigate an accident.

title: The Shorinkyo Incident
overview: Nanoka and Otoya infiltrate the Shorinkyo cult, but get trapped inside by the leader, Shoko.

title: The Keystone
overview: Earthquakes plague Taisho-era Fifth Street. Mao and Otoya find a church atop a sacred keystone site.

title: Memories of That Day
overview: Nanoka reveals that she is from 100 years in the future. She goes back in time to question Mao.

title: The New Vessel
overview: In the Taisho era, Nanoka is abducted by Byoki. Mao tries to help but collapses.

title: Hyakka
overview: Mao is attacked by Hyakka, a fire-wielding onmyoji. He reveals a secret about the Goshikido.

title: Kamon
overview: Mao and the gang help the injured Tenko. Kuchinawa, who appears on the scene, turns out to be Kamon.

title: Taizanfukun
overview: A giant made of fish and water demands that Mao teach him the ultimate onmyoji spell, Taizanfukun.

title: Blood Bond
overview: Mao tries to help a sick boy but walks into a trap. A shikigami attacks Mao, trying to capture him.

title: Water Sorcerer
overview: Mao recalls the Goko Clan's water sorcerer. Kamon reunites with Shiranui at a water temple.

title: Byoki
overview: Nanoka carries Byoki's message for Mao to the Taisho era. Kamon exposes Shiranui's scam.

title: The Iron Mask
overview: Rumors of a life-extending Goko Clan onmyoji lead Kamon and Mao to investigate Yurako.

title: Shiranui
overview: Shiranui demands the Taizanfukun spell from Mao, but Mao is enraged that Yurako is working for him.

title: Hakubi
overview: Hakubi attacks Mao with Metal sorcery. Mao transforms into a beast and goes on a rampage.

title: Maogui
overview: After battling Hakubi, Mao falls into a deep sleep. Nanoka and Shiraha investigate cats and Onmyodo.

title: Natsuno
overview: Natsuno reveals Daigo and Sana's past. Mao and Kamon unlock the mystery of the Undersea Shrine.

title: The Undersea Shrine
overview: Mao and his crew head for the Undersea Shrine. Kamon is driven into a corner by Shiranui's sorcery.

title: Sana's Heart
overview: Kamon seeks Masago's stolen body. Natsuno links Yurako's evil energy to Sana's death.

title: Soma
overview: After battling Ichima Kagami, Mao takes the injured Soma to the clinic, but Soma slips away.

title: Risk My Life
overview: A cursed puppet needle transforms Mao into a beast and turns him against his friends.

title: The Sleepwalking Patient
overview: Mao follows a patient who slips out of the hospital to eat grave dirt and uncovers a powerful curse.
